what: Preview packing report for the web performance candidate (bgeo.pack_preview). Source: analysis masters output/tiles and output/overview_b0.glb (read only).
flags: gltfpack 0.22 -cc -vp 16 -kn -ke -km -kv -vtf; per group one merged mesh; feature index in TEXCOORD_0.x; NORMAL kept for terrain only; records in .features.json

tiles.position_bound: 16-bit grid over each merged tile mesh (about 8 mm step; meshes that overhang the 500 m tile have a slightly coarser step). Measured: largest difference between a feature bounding box in the master and in the preview = 6.11 mm. This is a per-feature bounding-box check, not a bound on every vertex. The published full_B8 copies used a 16-bit grid per feature (finer).

overview.position_bound: terrain: one 16-bit grid over 8.1 km = 12 cm step, as in the published overview (measured 6.1 cm); building parts: 2 km blocks = 3 cm step (measured 1.6 cm), finer than the published overview
